native_followup_plan.reason: Original native series shifted from about 0.37 to 0.31 seconds in both binaries; pooled medians and matched-pair reductions disagree.
native_followup_plan.order: baseline/candidate on odd pairs, candidate/baseline on even pairs
native_followup_plan.settings: Unchanged frozen binaries, verifier, fixtures, resource budgets and environment
native_followup_plan.retention: Keep all original and follow-up samples; report the two series separately
native_followup_plan.stopping_rule: One twenty-pair follow-up regardless of outcome

selected: Constant-index LDE sponge absorption with exact prefix/full-block/suffix handling
One reduction of the eight-word Poseidon2 internal sum using 32-bit limb accumulators
rejected: Portable specialized squaring: inconsistent results, slower on most shapes
Carry-count deferred sum: slower than limb sums
Aligned-only absorption: superseded by handling all offsets without dynamic state indexing
Explicit hash loop unrolling: no consistent added benefit
selection.status: adopted after correctness checks and complete-proof comparisons
selection.prequalification_status: selected for complete-proof qualification; no end-to-end speedup claim yet
selection.final_assessment: The candidate won all 11 aggregation pairs, reducing median proving time by 1.52% for four inputs, 1.30% for eight inputs, and 2.17% for two concurrent eight-input jobs. Native latency is variable: the original pooled median was 6.09% slower despite 12/20 paired wins, while the separate follow-up median was 1.37% faster with 14/20 wins. Both native series are retained; no stable native latency improvement is claimed.

timer_boundaries.four: Aggregation call plus GPU drain; excludes context initialization, artifact output and CPU audit.
timer_boundaries.single: Cohort launch to worker exit; includes initialization, start barrier, aggregation, artifact output and shutdown; excludes CPU audit.
timer_boundaries.concurrent: Cohort launch to last of two worker exits; includes both initializations, start barrier, aggregations, artifact output and shutdown; excludes CPU audits.
timer_boundaries.wallet: Native ABI proving call plus GPU drain; excludes context initialization, buffer setup, artifact output and CPU audit.

limitations: One Tesla V100-PCIE-32GB; fixed demo/aggregation fixtures and bounded resource settings.
Warmed alternating pairs; first-use profiles and warmups excluded from qualification medians.
Five four-input pairs, three single eight-input pairs, three two-job concurrent pairs, twenty native JoinSplit pairs.
Kernel event totals and inclusive host spans are not additive.
No cold-cache, Apple GPU, full-block or production qualification in this run.
The dedicated NVIDIA cooperative hashing kernels and Metal implementation were not changed.
